info.name: Livestock ERP Sales API
info.description: Postman collection for animal batch sales. Sales drafts do not post stock or accounting. Confirming posts paid plus FOC animals to the batch movement ledger, paid amounts to an active branch cashbook, and unpaid amounts to customer receivables. Later receipts reduce AR; cancelling reverses stock, cash receipts, and remaining AR. Requires active customers, farms, animal batch balances, a branch cashbook, and an active cash-in category. All URLs use /api/v1. Select IDs from the prerequisite requests before creating a sale. Over-limit credit is blocked; sale.backdate is required for past dates.
